source: Kev, 19 Nov 2026 brain dump: finish JOs before checking out new; about 20 RPs/day = 3 JOs; about 15 RPs/day = max 2. Standard 15 RPs/day, 75/week (Must-Do 2, 15 by noon).

rp_standard.working_days: Mon to Fri, excluding Sabbath (Fri sunset to Sat sunset)

jo_checkout.pace: avg_rps_per_working_day = sum(RPs logged on the last 5 completed working days) / 5. Today is excluded. If fewer than 5 days exist, divide by days available.
jo_checkout.open_definition: A JO is open from check-out until the person marks it finished (or Kev/Nick closes it). Finish before checking out new.
jo_checkout.display: Show pace, limit, open count and a plain line: 'You can check out N more' or 'Finish a JO first'. Source and time on the number.
assumptions: 'About' in Kev's words is treated as the exact thresholds above; no rounding.
Below 15 RPs/day was not stated; (A) one JO. Kev to confirm.
Partial days and new hires in week 1 to 2 use the ramp: limit 1 until C1 is signed.

scorecard_on_desk.source: board/current (same schema as the Round Table); label 'Crelate as of <time>'. Partial week marked partial. No fake numbers: if not wired, say 'coming'.

visibility.intern: own desk; scorecard also visible to Bridger
visibility.discussion: Scorecards are discussed in person; the Hub shows numbers, never schedules a review.
